scope: pricing tiers, cache pricing, provider-reported totals, and provider gating
tdd_observations: Before the cost model implementation, targeted usage and OpenRouter tests failed to compile because Usage had no cost field and the provider accounting types were absent.
Before provider gating, a generic OpenAI parser test observed cost.total=0.004 from OpenRouter fields; after routing the flag, it retains catalog total.
Before telemetry integration, provider-reported cost emitted the catalog fallback; after integration the span and pi.ai.cost measurement use the reported total.
Before the direct terminal tests, ModelInfo::apply_response_cost had only indirect fixture coverage; the new tests lock catalog breakdown replacement and provider-total preservation.

The model-wire metadata fixture initially omitted Anthropic message_delta.stop_reason and failed with the intended pending-stop guard; adding the protocol-required end_turn event restored the test without weakening production validation.
Radius browser OAuth tests shared fixed port 1456 without a dedicated test lock; parallel execution could hide the authorize URL. A Radius-specific mutex now serializes those cases.
The platform delivery test still rejected the documented telemetry-tracing feature union; it now asserts the default plus telemetry-tracing contract and continues to reject optional dependencies.

The schema-engine regression showed that a relative reference kept its resource base but searched only a retrieved lexical subtree; local resolution now searches the document root while preserving the active base, so sibling $id resources remain identity-specific.
